Messages.Author: Valas
Messages.Body:
Question. If you have three Ventrue Investments out with blood on
them, can you give up a master action to pull one blood off each
investment or is it give up master action to pull one blood off one
investment?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The latter. You don't give it up. You use it. Just like you can use it to play a
master card (not use it to play three master cards).
